title: UP B.Ed. Result 2026 Out
intro: Short Information : Bundelkhand University, BU Jhansi has released the result for the Uttar Pradesh B.Ed. Joint Entrance Examination 2026. Applications for the UP B.Ed. Online Form 2026 were accepted from 10 February 2026 to 30 April 2026. The written examination was held on 31 May 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UP B.Ed. Result 2026 from the link given below.
importantDates: With Late Fee Last Date : 5 May 2026
applicationFee: With Late Fee General, OBC, EWS : 2000/-
Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
